## Change and mathematical scope

The P104 onboarding route links the native G/2 channel but does not distinguish the later pooled-space, relay-lifetime and source-acquisition contracts. This adds `docs/research/p104-helper-lifetime-scope-map.md` and links it from the bottleneck brief.

The map is a narrower successor to [Aaron Wang's PR2133](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2133), which already covers the earlier temporal/transport cuts and conditional 328/9 budget. It compares six exact-source contracts and four later examples:

- 96 shared rational dimensions versus 96 additional whole-array transports;
- 208 monotone lifetimes, including the extension with free root-code/private information;
- the target-specific 48-lifetime Y0 theorem and the 78-lifetime Y0/Y1 sharing construction;
- boundary rank progress versus recursive excess, with the fixed-template relay-v2 failure and the arrival-shape correction kept separate;
- logical, native-forward and complete-supplier evidence boundaries.

This is a **source-bound navigation audit**, not a new theorem, independent reimplementation, supplier or kappa claim. The original sources and selected record are unchanged. The four later examples are source-inspected, not newly replayed here. No new package or redundant verifier is introduced; existing registered packages provide the evidence.

For a literal correction, derive its full bill and retain the legal1,7,1 arrival as a positive case for any stronger profile constraint. Check the live canonical thread before reserving any of these questions; the map does not declare them unclaimed.

No new research claim continues after this documentation contribution. Complete hosting, physical interfaces and all-size admission remain obligations of the underlying constructions.
